name: cavity magnon polariton with magnon Kerr nonlinearity (YIG sphere in a microwave cavity)
question: Does the drive power cross a fold of the magnon-Kerr bistability (threshold write), and can a second parameter unfold it into a symmetric write?
assumptions: H = Delta_c a^dag a + Delta_m b^dag b + g(a^dag b + a b^dag) + K b^dag b b^dag b + i eps (b^dag - b) (Wang et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 120, 057202 (2018), driven magnon mode); units of the cavity loss
cavity detuned (Dc = 10) so that it does not add damping to the magnon mode; with a resonant cavity the added damping g^2/(kc/2) removes the bistability
mean field, vacuum noise kappa/8; class found in the corpus census (245 quantum-computing abstracts on magnon elements), not in the review census

provenance.source: Wang, Zhang, Shen, Zhang, Tang, You, Phys. Rev. Lett. 120, 057202 (2018)
provenance.kind: classical image of a corpus-census class

closure: cavity loss kc, magnon damping km
